header.title: PE ownership of Cree LED may sharpen focus and expand lighting LED share

s01_bottom_line.text: Penguin Solutions agreed to sell Cree LED to Transom Capital Group in an all-cash deal expected to close in 1Q27; Cree LED generated nearly US$200m in 2025 lighting LED revenue (~5% share, fifth worldwide) and is positioned to gain share as Samsung LED exits. ⟨cited figures: approximate⟩

TrendForce frames the PE takeovers of Cree LED and Lumileds as developments likely to have lasting influence on the competitive dynamics of the global lighting LED supply chain, drawing industry attention.
The ownership change and Samsung LED's exit could let Cree LED gain lighting LED share, but the article quantifies no earnings or margin impact and the new owner's pricing/R&D path is unknown.

items.text: Cree LED generated nearly US$200 million in lighting LED revenue in 2025. ⟨cited figures: approximate⟩
Cree LED captured approximately 5% of the global lighting LED market, fifth worldwide, in 2025. ⟨cited figures: approximate⟩

The all-cash transaction is expected to close in 1Q27, with purchase price undisclosed.
Lighting applications accounted for 81% of Cree LED revenue in the first three quarters of 2026.
With Samsung LED exiting the market, Cree LED is well positioned to expand its share.
